notes: The contemporaneous xAI model page archived on 2025-06-08 lists Grok 3 input, cached-prompt, and completion token prices corresponding to $3, $0.75, and $15 per million tokens; it contains no cache-write price. This supports models.dev correcting its own cache_write entry, not a provider price change. No effective date applies.
